description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisition  of land in Bankiyawatta, Bangawatta, Balangoda D/S Division, Ratnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters, specifically providing notice of compensation deposits for acquired lands under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with descriptions, lot numbers, extents, and compensation amounts, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
